mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate, indicating tighter monetary policy, leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced consumer and business spending, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.1 percentage points in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of cases when FEDFUNDS increases by >0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 7% signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of cases when UNRATE is below 7%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates increased demand for housing and related goods, leading to positive economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of cases when HOUST increases by >5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity and supply, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of cases when INDPRO increases by >1%.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth combined with rising inflation indicates stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate decreases and CPIAUCSL increases
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of cases when GDPC1 growth slows and CPIAUCSL rises.

mechanism_narrative: Consistent growth in non-farm payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of cases when PAYEMS grows consistently.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of cases during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate combined with high federal funds rates indicates economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases and FEDFUNDS are above 0.1%
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of cases when UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS are high.
